answers.core:
- TileMapLayer is a core tool for 2D world building in Godot. Per-tile offsets would significantly enhance the usability and flexibility of TileMap editing for all genres (RPGs, platformers, tactics, etc.).

- This feature would leverage existing runtime capabilities and make them accessible at the editor level, improving the core workflow without requiring external tools.

- An add-on cannot reliably extend the TileMapLayer editor tools to support custom per-tile offset editing natively and in a performant way.
answers.workaround:
- Offsetting tiles is a common requirement for modern 2D games, especially in RPGs, platformers, and roguelikes that want to break grid rigidity.

- TileMapLayer already supports custom transforms internally. The editor simply lacks a way to author them.

- Implementing this at the engine/editor level guarantees that the feature is robust, consistent, and saved properly in scene files.

title: Add per-tile custom offsets in TileMapLayer editor
